name: Bass, Steady
description: Keeps a bass in place: a firmer ratio, slow to take hold and slow to let go.

name: Drum Bus, Fast
description: The fixed timing: quick on each hit and gone before the next.

name: Mix, Fixed and Manual
description: The combined timing: a short peak is let go at once, and a long passage by the release knob.

name: Vocal, Gentle
description: Holds a voice a little, taking hold and letting go at an easy pace.
